notes.title: FIRST TIME broadcasting Embers of the Evening Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871065/1446dff61a65dcd6bd8f2b2413a00a4616a00e4d.png[/img]

[h2]Embers of the Evening is a first-person psychological horror game that has some Lovecraft inspirations.[/h2]

The game takes place aboard a solitary ship sailing across a sunless world, in search of the lighthouse that you'll never reach...

Every day, you'll struggle to fend off the darkness engulfing both the ship and your mind. And yet, the worst challenge will always come when you close your eyes.

Will you be trapped in a nightmare, or is it reality?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871065/48a90add5b9bad4fcf8a6c9766fabda595645d4d.gif[/img]


[h2]And so, during the Lovecraftian Days Steam event we'll be playing our unpublished demo![/h2]

We're glad to see Embers of the Evening featured at the Lovecraftian Days Festival. We're joining the event by showcasing our demo for the first time and we may drop any other video of the game too.

Don't forget to wishlist Embers of the Evening if the game caught your interest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706010/Embers_of_the_Evening/


More news coming really soon!

notes.title: Lovecraftian Days 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871065/1446dff61a65dcd6bd8f2b2413a00a4616a00e4d.png[/img]

[h1]Embers of the Evening is featured on the Lovecraftian Days Event of Steam.[/h1]

First time posting here!
We’re glad to see Embers of the Evening featured on the Lovecraftian Days Festival.

The festival has just begun and will last until the 8th of April. It consists of showcasing the major Lovecraftian horror games on Steam.

This type of horror was created by H.P. Lovecraft, an American writer of horror fiction. You can find some special games out there based on this terror, we will be checking them out too.

We hope you enjoy this festival as much as we do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871065/229258ce0f8bd362351af8199a62ea33a82eba9a.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706010/Embers_of_the_Evening/
